title: Concept: A declared name is one edit away from `strip-json-comments`
description: package.json declares a declared dependency name in package.json within one edit of `strip-json-comments`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The dependency graph an installer resolves comes from these names, so a name that only looks like the intended package pulls foreign code into the build. The name this rule expects is `strip-json-comments`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The dependency graph an installer resolves comes from these names, so a name that only looks like the intended package pulls foreign code into the build. The name this rule expects is `strip-json-comments`.
